integrity: The proof is analytic and does not rely on numerical experiments, finite sampling, or attainment of a supremum. The only nontrivial imported premise is the published all-space isosceles representation of the James constant.
scientific_limitations: The result is a short structural consequence of the isosceles representation of the James constant. Literature searches cannot exclude an unindexed prior observation, and no claim is made about the source paper's J_3 or J_4 constants.
title: The isosceles metric James constant coincides with the metric James constant
